ST-03.title: Make the Tax Year restated-months notice link to months the Monthly tab actually shows
ST-03.notes: Design gate already produced an Approved decision record + fully-written reports.md v0.20 spec section for this story; implemented per that spec exactly. Backend: added get_monthly_pnl_by_tax_year (database.py) and an optional year param on get_monthly_pnl_report()/GET /reports/monthly-pnl (backward-compatible; omitting year is unchanged rolling-window behaviour). Frontend: TaxYearReport's notice link now passes its selectedYear up to Reports' new monthlyInitialYear state; MonthlyPnlTable gained its own Tax Year filter (Select, same pattern as the Tax Year tab's own selector) seeded from that value, defaulting to the current UK tax year on direct tab navigation (reset via the plain nav button's onClick). Opportunistic in-file fixes (small, same-file, disclosed in commit): corrected reports_endpoints.md's stale 'No query parameters' line to also document the pre-existing, previously-undocumented format=csv param; reordered the CSV download URL to format=csv&year=... so an existing test's exact-prefix route regex still matches; added a wildcard to one pre-existing test's exact-string monthly-pnl route mock in reports-performance-tab.spec.js (broken by the new always-present ?year= query string). Also fixed a real, already-committed regression from this same session's ST-01 partial-migration batch pass: Reports.js's Tax Year Trades Table pnl_pct cell had been incorrectly given the three-way zero-neutral colour rule during ST-01's opportunistic zero-P&L fixes -- DEV-REPORTS-ST01-02/decision_record.md §5 explicitly scopes that convention to the Realised P&L column only; reverted to the original two-way rule (>0 emerald / else rose), confirmed by tests/e2e/reports-realised-pnl-zero-colour-convention.spec.js SC-RPZ-05 (which was failing before this fix, passing after). New tests: tests/test_monthly_pnl_tax_year_filter.py (6 backend unit/endpoint tests, all passing) and tests/e2e/tax-year-restated-notice-year-scoped-link.spec.js (3 Playwright scenarios covering the story's own 'older tax year' AC, direct-navigation default, and re-filter behaviour -- all passing). Full backend suite (1861 tests) and the full existing Reports/Monthly/TaxYear Playwright suite re-run clean after all fixes. Two genuinely pre-existing, unrelated test issues discovered during this regression pass were NOT fixed in-line (out of this story's scope) -- one already tracked (BLG-QA-190, test_monthly_ai_cost.py's unrestored sys.modules['database'] swap, confirmed via git-stash bisection to reproduce identically pre-ST-03), one newly filed (BLG-QA-197, reports-performance-tab.spec.js SC-REP-04a's stale zero-P&L sign-convention assertion, also confirmed pre-existing via the same bisection method).

ST-05.title: Responsive-table behaviour spec for Positions, TradeHistory and TradePlans
ST-05.notes: Documentation-creation story (Case B) -- inspected the actual current implementation (src/pages/Positions.js + src/components/ui/DataTable.js; src/components/trades/TradeHistoryTable.js; src/pages/TradePlans.js) rather than inventing new behaviour, and found all three docs' existing 'Responsive Behavior' bullets were factually wrong (claimed the tables collapse to cards below 768px; actual behaviour is DataTable's overflow-x-auto horizontal scroll with no column-hiding/priority logic at all -- only Positions' separate Grid view, a card layout, is genuinely responsive). Corrected positions.md (v2.9->2.10), trade_history.md (v1.13->1.14) and trade_plan.md (v1.16->1.17) to state the real behaviour per table, each with a Change Log/Changelog row. No code changed -- pure spec correction, matching the pattern trade_plan.md's own v1.11 entry already established for this exact document. No Playwright test required: this story's AC ('Three tables have stated behaviour in the frontend specs') is a documentation-accuracy criterion with no new/changed observable UI behaviour to test.

ST-06.title: Canonical keyboard-shortcut inventory spec
ST-06.notes: Documentation-creation story (Case B). Grepped Layout.js, CommandPalette.js, TradeEntry.js, TradePlan.js, RedFlagJournal.js and TickerUniverse.js for every onKeyDown/e.key handler (confirmed exhaustive via a second broader re-scan). Found: 4 global document-level shortcuts (Layout.js's n/w/r, CommandPalette.js's Cmd/Ctrl+K), already documented in navigation.md's existing Keyboard Shortcuts section, plus 4 page-local element-scoped Enter/Space handlers (tag-add in TradeEntry.js/TradePlan.js, filter-apply in RedFlagJournal.js, a custom role=button badge's keyboard-activation in TickerUniverse.js) that had no documented home anywhere -- exactly the gap BLG-SPEC-159 describes. Added both tables plus a conflict analysis to navigation.md v1.6->1.7: no conflicts found, and the reason is structural (global handlers are input-focus-suppressed by construction, so they and the page-local handlers are mutually exclusive by focus state; the 4 global shortcuts don't collide with each other since Cmd/Ctrl+K's own handler is gated behind the exact modifier check Layout.js's bare-key handler excludes). No conflicts required filing, satisfying the AC's 'conflicts resolved or filed' as 'none exist.' No code changed; no Playwright test required (AC is a documentation-completeness criterion, no new/changed observable behaviour).
